estonia.title: Estonia's top defense officials point finger at predecessors
estonia.description: At a Riigikogu special committee hearing, the Defense Ministry blamed procurement problems on the Estonian Center for Defense Investments, which in turn blamed its former director. The EDF acknowledged lacking a modern inventory system.

estonia.title: Court issues mostly suspended terms in conscription‑evasion scheme
estonia.description: Harju District Court ruled Wednesday that Andrei Vesterinen, Janika Butkevitšus and Armylaw OÜ were guilty of fraud and submitting false information to the Defense Resources Agency (KRA). The court did not find evidence of document forgery or use of forged documents.

estonia.title: Cost of electricity forecast to keep growing due to soaring natural gas prices
estonia.description: While cheaper in August year-over-year, electricity became noticeably more expensive in the second half of the month, while developments in the gas market are tending to keep electricity prices higher.

estonia.title: Estonia elects new president
estonia.description: Estonia's parliament elected Chancellor of Justice Ülle Madise as the country's next president on Wednesday after one round of voting.

estonia.title: Raimond Kaljulaid: Putin may be preparing to expand the war
estonia.description: Casino players who have lost heavily sometimes put their last savings on the table, take desperate risks and lose everything. Vladimir Putin may decide that everything must be thrown into the fight against Ukraine (and the West), Raimond Kaljulaid writes.

estonia.title: Estonian PM: Defense minister can decide whether to resign on Thursday
estonia.description: Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform) said Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur (Reform) bears no personal blame for questionable defense deals, but may still take political responsibility after talks on Thursday.

estonia.title: Prosecutor expands probe into theater director ecstasy drink‑spiking case
estonia.description: The Prosecutor's Office has expanded its investigation into a theater director's alleged drugging of acquaintances, Eesti Ekspress reported.

estonia.title: UAE travel from Estonia plunges as airlines cut Dubai flights
estonia.description: The number of people traveling to the United Arab Emirates has fallen dramatically since the start of the military conflict between the United States and Iran, said travel agent Mauri Saarend.

estonia.title: Gallery: EKRE holds protest ahead of presidential vote
estonia.description: The Conservative People's Party of Estonia (EKRE) held a protest Wednesday in front of the parliament building before the Riigikogu's extraordinary session to demand the introduction of direct presidential elections.

estonia.title: Madise: Estonia's independence an opportunity and obligation to make the best decisions
estonia.description: When did it happen that we stopped fighting for the best possible future for Estonia and instead often started fighting one another. From here on, we must do better, presidential candidate Ülle Madise said on Tuesday in a speech to the Riigikogu before voting started in the presidential election.

estonia.title: Harri Tiido: On Poland's foreign policy strategy
estonia.description: This time, the focus is on Poland's foreign‑policy strategy. Poland has been a consistent and in many ways crucial supporter of Ukraine, but recently tensions rooted in differing historical memories have resurfaced, Tiido notes.

estonia.title: Estonia's presidential election takes place on Wednesday
estonia.description: Estonia's MPs will vote to elect the next president on Wednesday when the first round of voting takes place in the Riigikogu.

estonia.title: Estonian midfielder Kristal joins Swiss club Thun on loan from Köln
estonia.description: Estonian national team midfielder Patrik Kristal will join Swiss top-flight club FC Thun on loan, where he will be joining teammate Mattias Käit.

estonia.title: Vaher: Former RKIK director is responsible for failed €70 million shell deal
estonia.description: The director general of the Estonian Center for Defense Investments (RKIK), Elmar Vaher, told ERR in an interview that former RKIK head Magnus-Valdemar Saar is responsible for the failed €70 million shell deal. RKIK employees failed to follow the necessary financial management principles, he believes.

estonia.title: Photos: Santa Zukker's solo exhibition opens at Artius Gallery in Tallinn
estonia.description: On 28 August, Santa Zukker's solo exhibition "Mööda maastikke" (Along the Landscapes) opened at the Artius Gallery in Tallinn, bringing together the artist's work from the past year along with earlier cityscapes featuring naïvist and futuristic elements.

estonia.title: GALERII ⟩ Üleujutus katkestas Pärnu ühisgümnaasiumis õppetöö ja elekter lülitati osaliselt välja
estonia.description: Tugev paduvihm ja sellest tingitud üleujutus halvas mitmes Pärnumaa haridusasutuses õppetöö. Nii nagu mitmes teises maakonna koolis katkesid koolitunnid ka Pärnu ühisgümnaasiumis.

estonia.title: OTSEBLOGI ⟩ Kuidas läheb taas F1 autosse istuval Paul Aronil vabatreeningul?
estonia.description: Vormel 1 sarja 13., Itaalia GP algab reedel vabatreeningutega. Neist esimesel saab Alpine'i masinaga võimaluse Paul Aron. Sõiduks läheb kell 13.30, Postimees vahendab sündmusi otseblogis.

estonia.title: Katsuta kaardilugeja sai Paraguay karmis avariis nii tõsiselt viga, et jääb järgmiselt etapilt eemale
estonia.description: Toyota sõitja Takamoto Katsuta kõrvale istub hooaja 12. MM-etapil, Tšiili rallil tavapärasest erinev kaardilugeja.

estonia.title: Prokuratuur süüdistab noort naist oma vastsündinud lapse tapmises
estonia.description: Prokuratuur süüdistab 18-aastast naist selles, et ta tappis 2025. aasta novembris Jõgevamaal oma elusalt sündinud poja. Kohus arutab asja järgmisel nädalal lühimenetluses. Tõenäoliselt kuulutab kohus istungi kinniseks, sest seal käsitletakse tundlikke isikuandmeid.

estonia.title: Herem: peaminister uuris, kas oleksin valmis kaitseministriks asuma
estonia.description: Endine kaitseväe juhataja Martin Herem kinnitas Postimehele, et peaminister Kristen Michal (RE) uuris pärast tänast omavahelist taskuhäälingu salvestust, kas Herem oleks valmis kaitseministriks asuma.

estonia.title: Kas oled seda detaili oma rätikul märganud? Sellel on tähtis ülesanne
estonia.description: Paljudel rätikutel on servas teistsuguse koega triip, millele me tavaliselt erilist tähelepanu ei pööra. Tegelikult täidab see väike detail olulist ülesannet ning võib anda aimu ka sellest, kui kaua rätik oma kuju ja hea väljanägemise säilitab.

estonia.title: New Yorgi koolidesse tuleb tehisarukeeld – kuni 8. klassini!
estonia.description: New York kehtestab eelseisval õppeaastal oma avalikes koolides kuni 8. klassi õpilastele üheaastase generatiivse tehisaru kasutamise keelu. Keelu eesmärk on kaitsta nooremaid lapsi tehnoloogia liigse ja ebasobiva kasutamise eest, samal ajal kui vanematele õpilastele hakatakse õpetama tehisaru kriitilist kirjaoskust.

estonia.title: Korobeinik: eelhoiatuse puudumine ei vabasta linna kohustusest olla sellisteks ohtudeks valmis
estonia.description: Keskkonnaagentuur ei andnud eile õhtul eelhoiatust, et Pärnumaal võib tulla üleujutus, kuid varajane ja piisavalt täpne hoiatus oleks andnud Andrei Korobeiniku (KE) sõnul rohkem aega ennetavateks tegevusteks.

estonia.title: PALJU ÕNNE! ⟩ Moe-Meisi sai emaks: sünnitamine on ikka raju kogemus
estonia.description: Eesti fashionista Meisi Volt sai 1. septembri varahommikul emaks. Värske ema kinnitab, et nii tema kui ka pisitütar tunnevad end hästi. Kuigi sünnitus kulges õnnelikult, tunnistas Meisi, et nii pööraseks kogemuseks ei osanud ta end siiski ette valmistada.

estonia.title: VIKTOR EKSI ⟩ Kõige ohtlikum ohver võib olla see, kes ei näe välja nagu ohver
estonia.description: Meil on kummaline komme arvata, et päris ohver peab oskama ohver olla. Ta peab rääkima usutavalt, käituma loogiliselt, tahtma abi, võtma abi vastu ja tegema pärast seda mõistlikke otsuseid. Ideaalis peaks ta olema tänulik. Kui ta kõige selle juures kiiresti jalule tõuseb, on ta tubli ohver. Kui ta räägib oma ohvriks olemisest liiga palju, võib temast saada ohvrimeelne. Kui ta aga käitub valesti, tekib lõpuks kahtlus, kas ta üldse oli päris ohver, kirjutab patrullpolitseinik Viktor Eksi.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Ebatavaline vaatepilt Tallinn–Pärnu maanteel: ilvesepere käis teedeehitust uudistamas
estonia.description: Tallinn–Pärnu maanteel Haimre liiklussõlme juures sattus 2. septembri keskpäeval kaamera ette ootamatu külaline. Teetööde vahetus läheduses seisis täiskasvanud ilves, kelle poeg oli pealtnägija sõnul jäänud teisele poole maanteed.

estonia.title: Soome tahab endised turbaalad metsastada, Eesti muudab need tagasi soodeks
estonia.description: Kaks naabrit, sama probleem ja sama kliimapõhjendus, kuid vastupidised lahendused. Soome valitsus valmistab ette toetust turbaalade metsastamiseks, Eestis läheb Euroopa Liidu raha nende taassoostamiseks.

estonia.title: Eesti eelmise hooaja pronksitiimi hämmastav seis: rivis 7 mängijat, peatreener sai rängalt vigastada
estonia.description: Eelmisel hooajal üle pika aja Eesti korvpallimeistrivõistluste medali, pronksi võitnud TalTech/Alexela läheb septembrile vastu vägagi haavatult.

estonia.title: LÄBIMURRE ⟩ Sea neer töötas mehe kehas rekordilised 271 päeva
estonia.description: USA arstid teatasid, et geneetiliselt muundatud sea neer töötas inimese kehas 271 päeva – kauem kui ükski varem siirdatud sea neer. See annab teadlastele lootust, et loomaelundeid võiks tulevikus kasutada elupäästva «sillana», mis aitaks patsiendil sobiva inimdoonori leidmiseni vastu pidada.

estonia.title: Läti soetab 28 miljoni euro eest maamiine
estonia.description: Läti valitsus eraldab kokku 28,3 miljonit eurot, et soetada maamiine sel ja kahel järgneval aastal, kirjutab uudisteagentuur LETA.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Pärnu üleujutuse keskel: kopraonu sisemine insener alustab tööd
estonia.description: Pole uudis, et koprad on usinad töörügajad: nende ehitatud uhkeid tamme võib jõe ääres jalutades ikka siin-seal näha. Vahel juhtub aga nii, et kobrastel ja inimestel on vajalikest ehitustöödest üks ja sama arusaam.

estonia.title: Mida teeb robot tänapäeva haiglas? Vastus ulatub operatsioonist kallistuseni – need 5 ongi juba kohal
estonia.description: Robotid on astunud ulmekirjandusest otse meditsiini argipäeva, täites tervishoius erinevaid olulisi rolle. Alates keerukatest operatsioonidest ja haiglakoridorides toimuvast logistikast kuni desinfitseerimise ning teraapiani aitavad tänapäevased meditsiinilised robotid vähendada personali koormust ning suurendada patsientide ohutust ja heaolu.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ «Aeg oli tõde päevavalgele tuua!» Nexuse laulja Janne Saar paljastas 23 aastat vana saladuse
estonia.description: Ansambli Nexus lauljana tuntuks saanud Janne Saar üllatas sotsiaalmeedias jälgijaid ülestunnistusega, mis viib tagasi enam kui kahe aastakümne taha. Selgub, et tema hääl kõlab ühes Terminaatori armastatud loos, ehkki paljud kuulajad pole seda kõik need aastad aimatagi osanud.

estonia.title: HEA TEADA ⟩ Kuidas kaitsta end lennu tühistamisel või sellest hoopiski teenida?
estonia.description: Läti lennufirma Air Baltic võtab lennuplaanist maha ohtralt Tallinnast väljuvaid otseliine ning liinilendude tühistamisega puutuvad ühel või teisel põhjusel aeg-ajalt kokku ka teiste lennufirmade kliendid. Tarbijakaitse (TTJA) ning Eesti suurima reisibüroo Estraveli spetsialistid aitavad luua ülevaadet, mida regulaarlendude tühistamisest teada võiks.

estonia.title: Sinijärv soovitab vahvat lugemist: «Kõik lapsevanemad, marss raamatupoodi!»
estonia.description: Rahvusraamatukogu kultuurinõunik Karl Martin Sinijärv soovitab lugeda Ilmar Trulli uut värsikogu «Riimiraamat ranitsasse».

estonia.title: Krypt alustab uut sügishooaega enam kui 50 bändi ja mitmekesise programmiga
estonia.description: Tallinna vanalinna serval tegutsev alternatiivmuusika klubi Krypt alustab uut sügishooaega mahuka programmiga, kuhu kuulub üle 50 bändi ning mitmeid kontserte, plaadiesitlusi ja eriilmelisi sündmusi. Sügishooaja jooksul jõuavad Krypti lavale nii Eesti alternatiivmuusika tegijad kui ka rahvusvahelised artistid

latvia.title: Amerikai katonai szakértő: 2029-ben támadhatnak az EU-ra az oroszok, mert akkor lesz a legsebezhetőbb a NATO légvédelme
latvia.description: Putyin elsősorban Németországot szemelte ki a hibrid hadviselés célpontjaként. A NATO-nak tennie kell azért, hogy a szürke zónás orosz akciókból ne legyen nyílt konfrontáció. Ki kell terjeszeni az Európát védeni hivatott brit és a francia atomernyőt. Aggályos, hogy Máltán felmentették az 2017-ben elkövetett újságíró-gyilkosság feltételezett értelmi szerzőjét. Témák és vélemények a világsajtóból.

latvia.title: Amerikai gigavállalatot ért támadás: üzent Washingtonnak az orosz hadsereg, Trump emberei Kijevbe indultak - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index pénteki hírösszefoglalója
latvia.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index pénteki hírösszefoglalója.

latvia.title: Felpörög a diplomácia Moszkvában és Kijevben, Trump követeli vissza a pénzét - Percről percre híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról pénteken
latvia.description: Volodimir Zelenszkij csütörtökön bejelentette , hogy a közeljövőben amerikai tárgyalóküldöttség látogat Kijevbe és Moszkvába az orosz–ukrán háború lezárását célzó diplomáciai erőfeszítések részeként. "A következő napokban várjuk őket, ez rendkívül fontos" - tette hozzá az ukrán elnök. Donald Trump amerikai elnök közben "némileg megkésve" kártérítést követel az Ukrajnának nyújtott támogatásért. Szerinte az európai országoknak vissza kellene fizetni azt a "több százmilliárd dollárt", amit "ingyen kapott" Ukrajna és a NATO. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül a legutóbbi fejleményekkel az orosz-ukrán fronton.

latvia.title: Rendkívüli lépés Kínától: látványos kamatemeléssel vadásszák a dollárt
latvia.description: Kínai kereskedelmi bankok az elmúlt hónapokban amerikai államkötvényeket vásároltak, miután megemelték dollárbetéti kamataikat. A stratégiaváltás egyszerre szolgálja a jüan erősödésének fékezését és a magasabb hozamok kihasználását – írja a Reuters.

latvia.title: Były senator PiS ciągnął psa za samochodem. Został skazany, ale części kary nie odbędzie
latvia.description: Sąd w Gdańsku ostatecznie już zdecydował, że były senator PiS Waldemar Bonkowski nie będzie wykonywał prac społecznych w ramach kary ograniczenia wolności, za znęcanie się nad psem. Postanowienie jest prawomocne i sprawa została ostatecznie zamknięta.

latvia.title: Prerobený štúrak vs. zatekajúce átriaky: Rekonštrukcia internátov UK naráža na limity aj financie
latvia.description: Nových 200 lôžok od septembra, ďalších 2 000 zostáva nedostupných.

latvia.title: Milei před volbami vsází na Falklandy. Trump mu hraje do karet
latvia.description: Ve světě vanou nové větry nakloněné argentinskému nároku na Falklandy, prohlásil ve čtvrtečním projevu argentinský prezident Javier Milei. Odkazoval hlavně na předchozí informaci, že jeho americký protějšek Donald Trump zvažuje, že argentinský nárok na souostroví pod britskou kontrolou podpoří, aby tak zatlačil na členské státy NATO.

latvia.title: Serghei Lavrov consideră că UE s-a transformat într-un „bloc militar antirus”: „NATO caută un motiv pentru a-şi prelungi existenţa”
latvia.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică nu va mai rezista mult timp, iar încercarea de a inventa noi pretexte pentru prelungirea existenţei NATO nu poate continua mult timp, a declarat joi ministrul rus de Externe, Serghei Lavrov, la Forumul Economic de la Vladivostok, relatează TASS, conform News.ro.

latvia.title: Rusia, imprevizibilă după impasul din Ucraina. Ce scenarii nu exclud SUA privind un atac asupra NATO
latvia.description: Reprezentantul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, a declarat la Fox Business că Rusia s-a împotmolit în Ucraina în timpul războiului. În același timp, Moscova ar putea fi pregătită să ia măsuri împotriva unei țări membre NATO.

latvia.title: China amenință Franța după legea care lovește Shein, Temu și AliExpress: „Va suporta toate consecințele”
latvia.description: China cere Franței să oprească aplicarea noii legi care vizează industria ultra-fast fashion, acuzând Parisul că impune restricții comerciale discriminatorii. Legislația prevede contribuții suplimentare de până la 12 euro pe produs în 2026, plafonul urmând să ajungă la 20 de euro în 2030, și afectează platforme precum Shein, Temu și AliExpress.

latvia.title: Oana Țoiu avertizează UE asupra intrărilor repetate ale dronelor rusești în România și cere întărirea Flancului Estic
latvia.description: Ministrul interimar al Afacerilor Externe, Oana Ţoiu, i-a informat pe omologii săi din UE cu privire la incursiunile ilegale repetate ale dronelor ruseşti în spaţiul aerian naţional şi în zona economică exclusivă a României şi a accentuat necesitatea de măsuri sporite de protejare a Flancului Estic, cu luarea în considerare a complementarităţii şi a instrumentelor UE - NATO.

latvia.title: Un senator demisionează din USR și critică partidul: „Nu vreau să devin spectatorul propriei mele tăceri”
latvia.description: Senatorul Gheorghe Ștefănache a demisionat din USR și va activa o perioadă ca independent, a acuzat organizația județeană Galați de „inactivitate asumată” și a criticat conducerea partidului pentru ruptura dintre direcția centrală și realitatea din teritoriu. Acesta a susținut că USR Galați trebuie să aibă candidați locali și afirmă că liderii partidului de la București nu vor candida la alegerile locale din Galați.

latvia.title: Răspunsul AUR la prioritățile anunțate de PSD pentru România. Petrișor Peiu: „Noi propunem, mai la firul ierbii, mai concret”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a prezentat marţi răspunsul AUR la cele zece priorităţi anunţate de PSD pentru România, punând în paralel măsurile celor două formaţiuni în domenii precum energia, apărarea, fiscalitatea, reforma statului, pensiile, educaţia, agricultura şi infrastructura. Petrişor Peiu susţine că în locul auditurilor, programelor, inventarelor şi mecanismelor propuse de PSD, AUR avansează măsuri concrete, de la oprirea decarbonizării şi revenirea la TVA de 19%, până la indexarea pensiilor, reducerea aparatului de stat şi finalizarea marilor proiecte de infrastructură.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, mesaj de felicitare pentru noul președinte al Estoniei: „Aștept cu interes să colaborăm îndeaproape”
latvia.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a felicitat-o pe Ulle Madise cu ocazia alegerii în funcția de președinte al Estoniei. În mesajul său, șeful statului a subliniat că România și Estonia sunt parteneri europeni apropiați și aliați în cadrul NATO, cele două țări fiind unite de o responsabilitate comună pentru securitatea regiunii.

latvia.title: Erdogan anunță că Turcia ar putea adera la blocul de securitate condus de China și Rusia. Ce spune despre relația cu NATO
latvia.description: Președintele Recep Tayyip Erdogan a declarat că Turcia va lua în considerare aderarea cu drepturi depline la Organizația de Cooperare de la Shanghai, blocul condus de China și Rusia. Erdogan susține că această posibilă aderare nu ar însemna o ruptură de Occident. Turcia, care deține a doua cea mai mare armată din NATO, este în prezent „partener de dialog” al OCS și singura țară din Alianța Nord-Atlantică asociată organizației, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Cum comentează George Simion discursul lui Nicușor Dan despre „naționalismul sănătos”: „Îl văd ca pe un încurcă lume”
latvia.description: George Simion îl cataloghează pe Nicușor Dan drept „un încurcă lume” și consideră „o naivitate” ideea că președintele ar putea atrage electoratul suveranist. Liderul AUR critică discursul susținut de șeful statului la Catedrala Mântuirii Neamului, unde acesta a vorbit despre un „naționalism sănătos”, și spune că folosirea acestei sintagme este „foarte periculoasă”.

latvia.title: UE și NATO, după atacul Rusiei la Leipzig: „Europenii se confruntă cu un adevăr dur. Aceasta este noua normalitate”
latvia.description: Președinta Comisiei Europene, Ursula von der Leyen, și secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, s-au întâlnit miercuri la Bruxelles, pentru a discuta despre atacul hibrid al Rusiei pe teritoriul german, respectiv la aeroportul din Leipzig, din august. NATO şi UE şi-au exprimat marţi solidaritatea cu Germania, după ce Berlinul a acuzat Moscova că se află în spatele atacului efectuat cu o dronă încărcată cu explozibili având drept ţintă aeroportul. Miercuri, șefa Comisiei Europene a transmis că NATO și UE vor continua presiunea asupra Rusiei și chiar o vor intensifica, până când aceasta va înceta războiul din Ucraina.

latvia.title: Leedu presidendi nõunik: on ebaselge, mis NATO 5. artikli käivitaks
latvia.description: On endiselt ebaselge, millised hübriidrünnakud või muud intsidendid käivitaksid NATO kollektiivkaitset käsitleva viienda artikli, ütles neljapäeval Leedu presidendi riikliku julgeoleku peanõunik Deividas Matulionis.

latvia.title: Latvian police make another cigarette smuggling bust
latvia.description: Latvian State Police said on September 4th that at the end of August, law enforcement officers from the Riga Regional Department detained a known illegal cigarette dealer in the Ziepniekkalns suburb of Rīga.

latvia.title: Latvian auto sprint round postponed due to weather
latvia.description: Due to adverse weather conditions, the Latvian auto sprint round in Talsi has been postponed until next Saturday, 12 September, the organisers have announced.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: White Night, Homo Novus, Chris Noah
latvia.description: Although it is technically autumn (and it sure looks like it), there are still plenty of festivals and festivities to take part in!

latvia.title: Autumn exhibition season upcoming at Rothko Museum
latvia.description: On Friday, 11 September, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils will open its Autumn exhibition season, bringing together artists of different generations from France, Italy and Latvia.

latvia.title: Riga IFF reveals short film programme
latvia.description: The Riga International Film Festival (Riga IFF), which will run from 15–25 October has announced its Short Film Competition programme.

latvia.title: No swimming in Lake Saldus due to bacterial presence
latvia.description: The results of an additional sample taken from Lake Saldus on 31 August have once again shown elevated levels of microbiological (E. coli) contamination in the bathing water, said the Health Inspectorate.

latvia.title: School equipment charity drive helps hard-pressed families
latvia.description: The charity campaign “Let’s Help Prepare for School Together!”, organised by the Akropole shopping malls and the charity organisation Ziedot.lv, has concluded after taking place for the seventh consecutive year.

latvia.title: Heavy rain alert Friday in northern, western Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, a yellow alert for heavy rain and thunderstorms is in force across Kurzeme and much of Vidzeme, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Latvia to spend EUR 28 million on land mines
latvia.description: Latvia plans to allocate 28.3 million euros to purchase mines this year and over the next two years, the LETA news agency reported on September 3.

latvia.title: Rēzekne spa centre finds tenant after over 20 auctions
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, the oral auction for the leasehold rights to the Rēzekne recreation or spa centre came to a close. A tenant has finally been found for the property, which the local authority had been seeking for some time, according to the Rēzekne City Council.

latvia.title: Rīga Airport begins terminal expansion
latvia.description: Rīga Airport is preparing for major changes – the passenger facilities will be expanded and equipped with new technology, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: airBaltic plans to get loan of 257 million euros
latvia.description: The Latvian airline ‘airBaltic’ has reached an agreement with investors on a loan of up to 257 million euros. The aim of the financing is to strengthen the company’s liquidity and secure the financial resources required to implement its new business plan. The interest rate has been set at 25 per cent per year, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Another hack in Latvia, more public data leaked
latvia.description: Another official database in Latvia has been raided by hackers, it emerged on September 3rd.

latvia.title: One killed in three-car crash near Ikšķile, Latvia
latvia.description: One person was killed and two others were injured in a three-vehicle collision on the Daugavpils road between Ikšķile and Ogre on Thursday, the State Police told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Belarus conference to take place in Rīga
latvia.description: On Friday, 4th September from 10.00 to 13.30, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host an international conference titled 'Conference on Belarus 2026'. The event is organised jointly by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Latvian Institute of International Affairs.

latvia.title: Latvia and Canada pool resources on Nepal disaster
latvia.description: Latvia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs provided another update on September 3rd on the status of dozens of Latvian citizens believed to be missing in Nepal following a catastrophic flood.

latvia.title: Saeima tightens up Latvia's e-identity laws
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 3rd, the Saeima supported amendments to the Law on Personal Identification Documents and amendments to the Law on Electronic Identification of Natural Persons in their final reading.

latvia.title: No more 'veggie sausages' as of 2029 in Latvia
latvia.description: On 18 August this year, a European Union (EU) regulation came into force stipulating that terms commonly used in the meat sector, such as “meat”, “bacon”, “steak” or “fillet”, may no longer be used for plant-based and other alternative products, the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Dombrava, Kozlovskis survive no confidence vote in Latvian parliament
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, Jānis Dombrava, Minister for the Interior (National Alliance), and Rihards Kozlovskis, Minister for Transport (New Unity), survived a vote of no confidence tabled by the opposition party Latvia First and several MPs not affiliated with any parliamentary group.

latvia.title: Insolvency fraud case under investigation in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police have completed a pre-trial investigation into alleged fraud in the provision of insolvency services, in which 57 people have been recognised as victims. The total loss amounts to at least 81,304 euros, the police said on September 3.

latvia.title: Latvia's Groglass to be sold to America's Apogee Enterprises
latvia.description: Latvian high-tech company Groglass, which develops and manufactures anti-reflective glass coatings, is being bought by US company Apogee Enterprises, it was announced on September 3rd.

latvia.title: NATO will be projecting oak in Latvia over next two weeks
latvia.description: From September 5th to 14th, the NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia will be conducting drills with the name "Oak Projection" at the Sēlija military training ground.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: One month to go timeline
latvia.description: With exactly one month until polling day for Latvia's 15th Saeima elections on October 3rd, here's a rundown of a few important dates and deadlines over the next four weeks.

latvia.title: Dahlia paradise coming to Latvian Nature Museum
latvia.description: From 10 to 13 September, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History will host the exhibition “Dahlias 2026”, featuring hundreds of dahlias – including both classic varieties that have become favourites over the years and new breeds, the museum announced.

latvia.title: President meets Pope
latvia.description: President of Latvia Edgars Rinkēvičs is visiting the Vatican on 3-4 September.

latvia.title: Around 60 reports on possible election campaign breaches filed in Latvia
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) has so far received around 60 complaints regarding possible pre-election campaign violations. These have been confirmed in at least four cases, Latvian Radio reported on September 2.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Facts & Figures
latvia.description: Why have boring old imprecise political opinions when you can have snappy and exact political statistics? Here is a selection thrown up by October 3rd's Saeima elections!

latvia.title: Alūksne hospital helps local farmers get rid of surplus produce
latvia.description: 'Kabaci vajag?' or 'Fancy a courgette?' is one of the most typical questions asked at harvest time, when there’s a bumper crop in your own and your neighbours’ gardens – and the same is true right now of tomatoes and other garden produce. This prompted staff at Alūksne Hospital to reach out to residents, farmers and home producers, asking them to share their surplus produce and make donations so that the patients’ menu could be expanded, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Man arrested for sexual abuse of minors in Latvia
latvia.description: A man born in 1967 has been arrested in Jelgava on suspicion of sexually abusing five minors, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Jelgava prison becomes tourist attraction
latvia.description: Jelgava Prison, which is more than 150 years old, ceased operations this summer, but its doors are now wide open to visitors. Guided tours allow visitors to see areas that were inaccessible to the public just a few months ago, Zemgale Regional Television reported on September 2.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 2nd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Pro-Russia author released from detention in Latvia
latvia.description: The Rīga City Court on Wednesday released from custody long-time pro-Russia activist Viktors Guščins, who is accused of violating sanctions imposed by the European Union (EU) by providing publications to a Russian propaganda resource.

latvia.title: Latvia congratulates the next President of Estonia
latvia.description: At its extraordinary session today, the Riigikogu, Estonia's national parliament elected Ülle Madise as the President of the Republic.

latvia.title: No honour guards at Freedom Monument this week in Latvia
latvia.description: During the first week of September, the ceremonial guard posts at the Freedom Monument and Rīga Castle will remain unmanned – this is due to military exercises.

latvia.title: Latvian average salary was 1,886 euros in second quarter
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on September 2 show that in Q2 2026 the average monthly gross wages and salaries stood at 1,886 euro (in full-time units). Compared with Q2 2025, the average monthly earnings before taxes increased by 78 euro or 4.3 %. Hourly earnings increased to 13.18 euro, or by 3.9 %.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: How the election works
latvia.description: October 3rd is another election day in Latvia. The country's democratic system is every bit as rigorous and complex as those in other countries, with polling stations opening both at home and across the globe, and this will be the 15th time a parliament, or Saeima, has been elected since the country won its independence in 1918.

latvia.title: Fewer destinations for Latvia's airBaltic next summer season
latvia.description: Latvia’s national airline, “airBaltic”, will offer 55 direct routes from Rīga throughout the 2027 summer season, which is fewer than during this year’s summer season, according to calculations by the LETA news agency based on information provided by airBaltic.

latvia.title: Zaube Wild Food Festival celebrates 10 years this weekend
latvia.description: On 5th September, the Zaube Wild Food Festival will celebrate its 10th anniversary. latvia.title: Namejs 2026 military drills take place throughout Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 2 September, the comprehensive national defence exercise ‘Namejs 2026’, organised by the National Armed Forces (NBS), begins across Latvia and will run until 8 October, according to representatives of the National Armed Forces.

latvia.title: Scammers use Nepal tragedy, says Latvian State Police
latvia.description: The State Police have received reports of incidents in which fraudsters have attempted to swindle money from the relatives of Latvians who have gone missing in Nepal, police said on September 1.

latvia.title: 'Operation Werewolf' extended until October in Latvia
latvia.description: Operation ‘Vilkatis’ (Werewolf), aimed at reducing illegal migration, will be extended until 3 October, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (‘United List’) announced at a press conference on Tuesday following a cabinet meeting.

latvia.title: Second round of Latvia's affordable housing programme cancelled
latvia.description: In the second round of the public-private partnership rental housing programme, the majority of the local authorities involved have decided not to continue their participation due to unpredictable costs, so the round has been cancelled, Latvian Radio reported on September 2.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 1st September, 2026

latvia.title: Kulbergs delivers damning verdict on Dombrava's immigration wishlist

Īpašu uzmanību sociālajos tīklos guvis kāds […]

lithuania.title: Amerikai katonai szakértő: 2029-ben támadhatnak az EU-ra az oroszok, mert akkor lesz a legsebezhetőbb a NATO légvédelme
lithuania.description: Putyin elsősorban Németországot szemelte ki a hibrid hadviselés célpontjaként. A NATO-nak tennie kell azért, hogy a szürke zónás orosz akciókból ne legyen nyílt konfrontáció. Ki kell terjeszeni az Európát védeni hivatott brit és a francia atomernyőt. Aggályos, hogy Máltán felmentették az 2017-ben elkövetett újságíró-gyilkosság feltételezett értelmi szerzőjét. Témák és vélemények a világsajtóból.

lithuania.title: Amerikai gigavállalatot ért támadás: üzent Washingtonnak az orosz hadsereg, Trump emberei Kijevbe indultak - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index pénteki hírösszefoglalója
lithuania.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index pénteki hírösszefoglalója.

lithuania.title: Felpörög a diplomácia Moszkvában és Kijevben, Trump követeli vissza a pénzét - Percről percre híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról pénteken
lithuania.description: Volodimir Zelenszkij csütörtökön bejelentette , hogy a közeljövőben amerikai tárgyalóküldöttség látogat Kijevbe és Moszkvába az orosz–ukrán háború lezárását célzó diplomáciai erőfeszítések részeként. "A következő napokban várjuk őket, ez rendkívül fontos" - tette hozzá az ukrán elnök. Donald Trump amerikai elnök közben "némileg megkésve" kártérítést követel az Ukrajnának nyújtott támogatásért. Szerinte az európai országoknak vissza kellene fizetni azt a "több százmilliárd dollárt", amit "ingyen kapott" Ukrajna és a NATO. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül a legutóbbi fejleményekkel az orosz-ukrán fronton.

lithuania.title: Rendkívüli lépés Kínától: látványos kamatemeléssel vadásszák a dollárt
lithuania.description: Kínai kereskedelmi bankok az elmúlt hónapokban amerikai államkötvényeket vásároltak, miután megemelték dollárbetéti kamataikat. A stratégiaváltás egyszerre szolgálja a jüan erősödésének fékezését és a magasabb hozamok kihasználását – írja a Reuters.

lithuania.title: Były senator PiS ciągnął psa za samochodem. Został skazany, ale części kary nie odbędzie
lithuania.description: Sąd w Gdańsku ostatecznie już zdecydował, że były senator PiS Waldemar Bonkowski nie będzie wykonywał prac społecznych w ramach kary ograniczenia wolności, za znęcanie się nad psem. Postanowienie jest prawomocne i sprawa została ostatecznie zamknięta.

lithuania.title: Prerobený štúrak vs. zatekajúce átriaky: Rekonštrukcia internátov UK naráža na limity aj financie
lithuania.description: Nových 200 lôžok od septembra, ďalších 2 000 zostáva nedostupných.

lithuania.title: Milei před volbami vsází na Falklandy. Trump mu hraje do karet
lithuania.description: Ve světě vanou nové větry nakloněné argentinskému nároku na Falklandy, prohlásil ve čtvrtečním projevu argentinský prezident Javier Milei. Odkazoval hlavně na předchozí informaci, že jeho americký protějšek Donald Trump zvažuje, že argentinský nárok na souostroví pod britskou kontrolou podpoří, aby tak zatlačil na členské státy NATO.

lithuania.title: Serghei Lavrov consideră că UE s-a transformat într-un „bloc militar antirus”: „NATO caută un motiv pentru a-şi prelungi existenţa”
lithuania.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică nu va mai rezista mult timp, iar încercarea de a inventa noi pretexte pentru prelungirea existenţei NATO nu poate continua mult timp, a declarat joi ministrul rus de Externe, Serghei Lavrov, la Forumul Economic de la Vladivostok, relatează TASS, conform News.ro.

lithuania.title: Rusia, imprevizibilă după impasul din Ucraina. Ce scenarii nu exclud SUA privind un atac asupra NATO
lithuania.description: Reprezentantul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, a declarat la Fox Business că Rusia s-a împotmolit în Ucraina în timpul războiului. În același timp, Moscova ar putea fi pregătită să ia măsuri împotriva unei țări membre NATO.

lithuania.title: China amenință Franța după legea care lovește Shein, Temu și AliExpress: „Va suporta toate consecințele”
lithuania.description: China cere Franței să oprească aplicarea noii legi care vizează industria ultra-fast fashion, acuzând Parisul că impune restricții comerciale discriminatorii. Legislația prevede contribuții suplimentare de până la 12 euro pe produs în 2026, plafonul urmând să ajungă la 20 de euro în 2030, și afectează platforme precum Shein, Temu și AliExpress.

lithuania.title: Oana Țoiu avertizează UE asupra intrărilor repetate ale dronelor rusești în România și cere întărirea Flancului Estic
lithuania.description: Ministrul interimar al Afacerilor Externe, Oana Ţoiu, i-a informat pe omologii săi din UE cu privire la incursiunile ilegale repetate ale dronelor ruseşti în spaţiul aerian naţional şi în zona economică exclusivă a României şi a accentuat necesitatea de măsuri sporite de protejare a Flancului Estic, cu luarea în considerare a complementarităţii şi a instrumentelor UE - NATO.

lithuania.title: Un senator demisionează din USR și critică partidul: „Nu vreau să devin spectatorul propriei mele tăceri”
lithuania.description: Senatorul Gheorghe Ștefănache a demisionat din USR și va activa o perioadă ca independent, a acuzat organizația județeană Galați de „inactivitate asumată” și a criticat conducerea partidului pentru ruptura dintre direcția centrală și realitatea din teritoriu. Acesta a susținut că USR Galați trebuie să aibă candidați locali și afirmă că liderii partidului de la București nu vor candida la alegerile locale din Galați.

lithuania.title: Răspunsul AUR la prioritățile anunțate de PSD pentru România. Petrișor Peiu: „Noi propunem, mai la firul ierbii, mai concret”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a prezentat marţi răspunsul AUR la cele zece priorităţi anunţate de PSD pentru România, punând în paralel măsurile celor două formaţiuni în domenii precum energia, apărarea, fiscalitatea, reforma statului, pensiile, educaţia, agricultura şi infrastructura. Petrişor Peiu susţine că în locul auditurilor, programelor, inventarelor şi mecanismelor propuse de PSD, AUR avansează măsuri concrete, de la oprirea decarbonizării şi revenirea la TVA de 19%, până la indexarea pensiilor, reducerea aparatului de stat şi finalizarea marilor proiecte de infrastructură.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, mesaj de felicitare pentru noul președinte al Estoniei: „Aștept cu interes să colaborăm îndeaproape”
lithuania.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a felicitat-o pe Ulle Madise cu ocazia alegerii în funcția de președinte al Estoniei. În mesajul său, șeful statului a subliniat că România și Estonia sunt parteneri europeni apropiați și aliați în cadrul NATO, cele două țări fiind unite de o responsabilitate comună pentru securitatea regiunii.

lithuania.title: Erdogan anunță că Turcia ar putea adera la blocul de securitate condus de China și Rusia. Ce spune despre relația cu NATO
lithuania.description: Președintele Recep Tayyip Erdogan a declarat că Turcia va lua în considerare aderarea cu drepturi depline la Organizația de Cooperare de la Shanghai, blocul condus de China și Rusia. Erdogan susține că această posibilă aderare nu ar însemna o ruptură de Occident. Turcia, care deține a doua cea mai mare armată din NATO, este în prezent „partener de dialog” al OCS și singura țară din Alianța Nord-Atlantică asociată organizației, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Cum comentează George Simion discursul lui Nicușor Dan despre „naționalismul sănătos”: „Îl văd ca pe un încurcă lume”
lithuania.description: George Simion îl cataloghează pe Nicușor Dan drept „un încurcă lume” și consideră „o naivitate” ideea că președintele ar putea atrage electoratul suveranist. Liderul AUR critică discursul susținut de șeful statului la Catedrala Mântuirii Neamului, unde acesta a vorbit despre un „naționalism sănătos”, și spune că folosirea acestei sintagme este „foarte periculoasă”.

lithuania.title: UE și NATO, după atacul Rusiei la Leipzig: „Europenii se confruntă cu un adevăr dur. Aceasta este noua normalitate”
lithuania.description: Președinta Comisiei Europene, Ursula von der Leyen, și secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, s-au întâlnit miercuri la Bruxelles, pentru a discuta despre atacul hibrid al Rusiei pe teritoriul german, respectiv la aeroportul din Leipzig, din august. NATO şi UE şi-au exprimat marţi solidaritatea cu Germania, după ce Berlinul a acuzat Moscova că se află în spatele atacului efectuat cu o dronă încărcată cu explozibili având drept ţintă aeroportul. Miercuri, șefa Comisiei Europene a transmis că NATO și UE vor continua presiunea asupra Rusiei și chiar o vor intensifica, până când aceasta va înceta războiul din Ucraina.

lithuania.title: Leedu presidendi nõunik: on ebaselge, mis NATO 5. artikli käivitaks
lithuania.description: On endiselt ebaselge, millised hübriidrünnakud või muud intsidendid käivitaksid NATO kollektiivkaitset käsitleva viienda artikli, ütles neljapäeval Leedu presidendi riikliku julgeoleku peanõunik Deividas Matulionis.

lithuania.title: NATO will be projecting oak in Latvia over next two weeks
lithuania.description: From September 5th to 14th, the NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia will be conducting drills with the name "Oak Projection" at the Sēlija military training ground.

lithuania.title: Jauns drauds NATO no Baltkrievijas puses: opozicionāre brīdina par Krievijas plāniem
lithuania.description: Agresorvalsts Krievija var izmantot Baltkrievijas teritoriju spriedzes saasināšanai un provokācijām pret NATO valstīm, komentārā medijam LRT paziņoja Baltkrievijas opozīcijas līdere Svetlana Tihanovska. Pēc viņas teiktā, pašpasludinātais Baltkrievijas prezidents Aleksandrs Lukašenko joprojām ir gatavs nodrošināt teritoriju un infrastruktūru iespējamām Krievijas uzbrukuma vai iebiedēšanas operācijām pret NATO. Viņa pastāstīja, ka saņēmusi datus par jaunas militārās infrastruktūras būvniecību […]

lithuania.title: “Tas ir tas, uz ko Kremlis spiež!” Slaidiņš atklāj galveno drošības risku Ukrainai un brīdina par Krievijas jauno taktiku
lithuania.description: Krievijas uzbrukumi Ukrainai arvien vairāk iegūst ilgstošas gaisa kampaņas raksturu, kuras mērķis nav tikai atsevišķu objektu iznīcināšana. Krievija cenšas vienlaikus noslogot Ukrainas pretgaisa aizsardzību, radīt zaudējumus infrastruktūrai un enerģētikai, kā arī psiholoģiski nogurdināt sabiedrību. TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš skaidroja, kādu risku šāda Krievijas taktika rada Ukrainai […]

lithuania.title: Premjeras ir konservatorių lyderis sutarė: oro gynyba – pirmas prioritetas
lithuania.description: Su opozicinių konservatorių pirmininku Laurynu Kasčiūnu penktadienį susitikęs premjeras, valdančiųjų socialdemokratų lyderis Mindaugas Sinkevičius sako, jog politikai sutaria dėl oro gynybos pirmumo krašto apsaugos prioritetų sąraše.

lithuania.title: Donaldas Trumpas paskyrė laikinąjį JAV kariuomenės sekretorių
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas ketvirtadienį pranešė skiriantis naują laikinąjį JAV kariuomenės sekretorių, Danui Driscollui atsistatydinus iš aukščiausio civilinio pareigūno pareigų dėl pranešimų apie nesutarimus su Pentagono vadovybe.

lithuania.title: Įtartinai panašus ir į moterį, ir į vyrą: policija tiria bjauraus poelgio bylą
lithuania.description: Kol kas nenustatytos tapatybės, panašu, moterimi persirengęs vyras, apgaule patekęs į vienos vilnietės butą Fabijoniškių gatvėje sostinėje, įtariamas pavogęs 3 000 eurų.

lithuania.title: „Čekiukų“ bylose ieškiniai pateikti aštuoniems Alytaus ir Lazdijų politikams
lithuania.description: Prokuratūros teismui pateiktuose naujausiuose civiliniuose ieškiniuose prašoma iš septynių Alytaus miesto bei vieno Lazdijų rajono savivaldybių tarybų narių priteisti galimai nepagrįstai jiems išmokėtas išmokas.

lithuania.title: Maskva gąsdina Witkoffą, kad Kyjive pavojinga: jis jautriai reaguoja į rusų nuotaikas
lithuania.description: JAV prezidento Donaldo Trumpo pasiuntiniai Steve'as Witkoffas ir Jaredas Kushneris planavo rugsėjo 5–6 dienomis apsilankyti Maskvoje bei Kyjive, tačiau S. Witkoffas „pradėjo baimintis“, todėl buvo pradėta diskutuoti apie alternatyvius planus, leidiniui „Kyiv Independent“ penktadienį teigė vienas su situacija susipažinęs šaltinis.

lithuania.title: Ant varžytynių stalo – mergaitės pagrobėjo Filipavičiaus garažo turinys
lithuania.description: Elektroniniame varžytynių ir aukcionų portale pasirodė skelbimai apie viešai parduodamą 20-čiai metų už mergaitės pagrobimą Kaune ir kitus nusikaltimus nuteisto Gedimino Filipavičiaus garažo turinį. Pardavimą vykdo antstolė.

lithuania.title: Slaptas Rusijos lėktuvo „Ruslan“ skrydis į Kaliningradą: anksčiau gabeno „Iskander“ raketas
lithuania.description: Rusijos karinis transporto lėktuvas An-124-100 „Ruslan“ su numeriu RA-82040 atliko skrydį į Kaliningrado sritį. Jo maršrutą užfiksavo stebėsenos tarnyba „AirNav Radar“. Kaip primena portalas „Unian“, An-124-100 „Ruslan“ 2022 metais buvo naudojamas „Iskander“ raketoms į Baltarusiją gabenti.

lithuania.title: Zelenskio įspėjimas Rusijai pavyko: pirmos avialinijos stabdo visus skrydžius į Maskvą
lithuania.description: Oro linijų bendrovė „Air Tanzania“ sustabdė skrydžius tarp Dar es Salamo ir Maskvos, motyvuodama rizikos vertinimu ir keleivių saugumu. Tai pirmoji užsienio oro bendrovė, atšaukusi skrydžius į Rusiją po Volodymyro Zelenskio įspėjimo apie pavojų Rusijos oro erdvėje.

lithuania.title: „Argentina nesėdės sudėjusi rankų“: Jungtinei Karalystei – naujo karo pavojus
lithuania.description: Argentinos lyderis Javieras Milei ketvirtadienį paaštrino ginčą su Jungtine Karalyste dėl Folklando salų. Prezidentas pažadėjo naujas priemones, skirtas sustabdyti naftos projektą netoli britų kontroliuojamo salyno, ir pagyrė JAV prezidentą Donaldą Trumpą.

lithuania.title: Galimi pažeidimai Raudondvario dvare: vadovybė laikinai nušalinta, kreiptasi į institucijas
lithuania.description: Kauno rajono savivaldybės meras Valerijus Makūnas kreipėsi į tris institucijas, prašydamas įvertinti viešojoje erdvėje paskelbtą informaciją apie galimus pažeidimus, vykdant Raudondvario dvaro viešuosius pirkimus.

lithuania.title: Trumpas pagrasino Britanijai dėl jos salų: „Nebuvote šalia“
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas užsiminė, kad nepadėtų Jungtinei Karalystei galimo konflikto su Argentina dėl Folklando salų atveju. Interviu „GB News“ Amerikos lyderis priminė, kad Britanija „nebuvo šalia, kad padėtų man“, kai jis pradėjo karą prieš Iraną.

lithuania.title: Nusikaltėlius domina ne vien automobiliai: dėl dalių apvogtas motociklas, neliko net benzino bako
lithuania.description: Savininkas policijai pranešė, kad nuo jo motociklo XV 1900 kažkas pavogė baką, žibintą, šoninius variklio uždengimus, kuro bako spynelę ir dvi kojų atramas.

lithuania.title: Izraelio gynybos ministras giria „Hezbollah“ kontroliuotos aukštumos užėmimą Libane
lithuania.description: Izraelio gynybos ministras penktadienį pasveikino kariuomenę, užėmusią strategiškai svarbią „Hezbollah“ kontroliuotą aukštumą Libane, kas, jo teigimu, sustiprins Izraelio „saugumo zoną“, ir pažadėjo, kad kariai iš ten nesitrauks.

lithuania.title: Ką turi mokėti septintokas? Suomija į šį klausimą atsakys visai šaliai
lithuania.description: Ką turi mokėti penktokas, septintokas ar devintokas? Suomijoje į šį klausimą nuo 2028 m. bus atsakoma vienodai visose mokyklose. Kiekvienai klasei ir mokomajam dalykui bus aiškiai nustatyta, kokį lygį mokinys turi pasiekti. Tačiau nauja tvarka apibrėš ne tik tai, ko tikimasi iš vaiko – ji numatys ir tai, ką mokykla turi daryti, kai jam nesiseka, rašoma „Švietimas #1“ pranešime žiniasklaidai.

lithuania.title: Užsienio reikalų ministras atsakė į premjero patarėjo kritiką: esame viename puslapyje
lithuania.description: Lietuvos diplomatijos vadovas Kęstutis Budrys premjero patarėjo kultūrai Dariaus Kuolio palyginimą, esą šalies užsienio politika primena minamą, tačiau iš vietos nejudantį dviratį, vadina kūrybinga metafora bei pabrėžia, jog veikia „viename puslapyje“ su Vyriausybe.

lithuania.title: Įniršusi Rusija – Norvegijai: „Reikalaujame nedelsiant“
lithuania.description: Norvegijai Ukrainos valstybinės energetikos grupės „Naftogaz“ reikalavimu, kad būtų galima atlyginti už konfiskuotą turtą, Arktyje sulaikius Rusijos laivą, Maskva ketvirtadienį pareikalavo jį nedelsiant paleisti.

lithuania.title: Diplomatijos vadovas optimistiškas dėl santykių su Kinija, bet sako, kad terminai apsunkina procesą
lithuania.description: Valstybės vadovams besitikint pažangos dėl santykių su Kinija normalizavimo iki Lietuvai pradedant pirmininkauti Europos Sąjungai, užsienio reikalų ministras Kęstutis Budrys sako esąs optimistiškas, kad tai pavyks pasiekti.

lithuania.title: Užsienio reikalų ministras: ES turėtų didinti, o ne mažinti spaudimą Baltarusijai
lithuania.description: Lietuvos diplomatijos vadovas Kęstutis Budrys sako nematantis pagrindo švelninti politiką Baltarusijos atžvilgiu, ragina sankcijas griežtinti.

lithuania.title: Lenkija nusprendė griežtai: uždarys oro erdvę palei sieną su Ukraina
lithuania.description: Nuo rugsėjo 10 d. iki gruodžio 9 d. Lenkija apribos oro eismą virš šalies rytinės dalies laikinoje zonoje, pažymėtoje kaip „EP R134“, rašo naujienų portalas „UNITED24“.

lithuania.title: Ministras: siūlymas pripažinti Rusijos žvalgybą teroristine organizacija – svarstytinas
lithuania.description: Užsienio reikalų ministras Kęstutis Budrys sako, kad tiek Lietuva individualiai, tiek ES galėtų pripažinti Rusijos žvalgybą teroristine organizacija.
